notes: Parts each Waves Pest Insider text names (owner 2026-11-19: show a picture when the email names a part). Checked by server/services/pest-insider/parts.js; drawn by ops/agents/pest-insider-parts.js. facts = lead facts by id (shown text: title + lead sentences). species = What's this? species by slug (shown text: its fact). A text with a part word (parts.js PART_WORDS) needs an entry. parts = the parts a reader can look for, in the text's words; [] = a person read the text and it names no part to show, and why says so. An entry with parts has a picture: heading (the text's own words); 1 or 2 panels, each a photo cropped to the panel's shape ([left, top, width, height] in photo pixels, after rotate) or a diagram; 2 panels both have a name (the text's own words) or neither does. Each panel has 1 to 3 marks: at = 1 or 2 circle centers, r = the circle radius, pill = the label's top-left corner, all in panel pixels (parts.js panelSize); label = the text's own words. photos = real photos only, never AI: CC0, CC BY 4.0 or Public domain, with the page they came from; the email shows a credit line under the picture. sha16 = the first 16 hex characters of the photo file's sha256. text16 = the first 16 hex characters of the sha256 of the text a person reviewed (parts.js textHash); when the text changes, a test fails until a person reviews the list again and updates text16.
